known_risks: the id key has its own errors (wrong codes, merged practices, branch surgeries sharing a code); this measures agreement with the key
CQC registers branch sites under one practice code in some cases; a branch paired with its main practice is labelled same
ODS points are postcode centroids; CQC points are geocoded addresses; distances are noisier than Nigeria's
the decider's LGA alias table is Nigerian; English authorities agree by exact folded name only, which helps because both sides use ONSPD names
the engine's Splink recipe needed names in one case (it trains on exact name agreement, case-sensitive); upper-casing is a preprocessing step, not a model change
Splink regions rebuild with identical edges, decisions and scores but a different row order; the files are pinned as built
next_steps_not_frozen: X12: X0 recipe fine-tuned on id-linked UK pairs from the six training regions (labels from the key only; no OSM, no libpostal output), combiner refitted on training-region held pairs; tested on the three held-out regions under this rule
engine defect: make the Splink place recipe's training rule case-insensitive (arche-core change, own test)
G0b: blind African address pack with a cased-input arm for arche's parser
question: Does nigeria-facility-decider-v1, unchanged and with no UK training, settle the engine's held pairs between CQC GP locations and ODS GP practices within the X-series bounds?

rule.decider: nigeria-facility-decider-v1 bundle as packaged (pins below): Nigerian thresholds, Nigerian alias table (no UK entries), located/hidden thresholds per pair
rule.error_bound: errors among auto-decided <= 3% and Wilson 95% upper bound <= 10%
rule.false_merge_bound: different pairs auto-matched / all different pairs <= 2% and Wilson 95% upper bound <= 5%
rule.fewer_held: coverage (matched + rejected) / scorable held pairs >= 0.20 and pair-bootstrap 95% lower bound >= 0.10 (10,000 resamples, seed 0)
rule.informative: void unless at least 60 different pairs
rule.interpretation: pass: the decider ships for UK GP lists as is. Fail on false merges: do not use it in the UK without X12. Fail on coverage only: safe but idle; X12 decides.
rule.population: every engine 'review' edge from build_uk_gp.py in the 9 English regions (1,004 held pairs), scored where the id key gives a label
rule.primary: transfer_pass: all four on the pooled 9 regions
rule.records: name upper-cased on both sides; admin1 = ONS region and admin2 = local authority district, from each record's own postcode (ONSPD Aug 2026); CQC point = its own latitude/longitude else postcode centroid; ODS point = postcode centroid
secondary: held_out_pass on North West, West Midlands, South East (every third region by code from the second); this is the baseline X12 must beat
reference arm match-everything, which must fail
linker view, best proposal per CQC location (compare_linkers rule): engine alone vs engine + decider, precision and recall against the key
rule.truth: same = ODS record's code equals the CQC location's 'Location ODS Code'; different = the CQC location's code belongs to another ODS record in the region's population; otherwise unscorable (reported, not gated)
